findings.issue: Card construction (species + types + note) is duplicated in three places: cardsForPokemon, loadHome (app/src/views/home.tsx:44) and loadTeam (app/src/views/team.tsx:61)
findings.suggestion: Extract a single toCard(species, typesById, note?) helper in data.ts so card shape changes are one edit

findings.issue: Sort-key vocabulary declared twice: SORT_KEYS in the router mirrors COLUMNS in the moves table (app/src/views/pokemon.tsx:32); adding/removing a sortable column needs both, and the router also reaches into MovesData internals at index.tsx:58
findings.suggestion: Export the key set (or a findTable helper) from views/pokemon.tsx and have the route import it, keeping moves knowledge in one module

findings.issue: Cross-feature coupling: the Pokémon page imports TEAM_SIZE/TeamButton from the team module and depends on team.tsx's '.team-action' hx-target markup contract
findings.suggestion: Move the team-button markup contract into components.tsx (or have the team feature own a wrapper), so the Pokémon page depends on a stable component, not team internals

findings.issue: details.tsx is a grab-bag holding moves, abilities and types, so feature removal/addition means editing a shared file rather than adding/removing a file
findings.suggestion: Split per resource (moves.tsx, abilities.tsx, types.tsx) — the MovePage pattern would then be an explicit template for an Items section

findings.issue: Effect-fallback expression (englishEffect || latestFlavorText || Dash) duplicated from details.tsx:14
findings.suggestion: Extract a displayEffect(entries, flavorEntries, chance?) helper in data.ts

findings.issue: The team module mixes cookie persistence, team domain logic and view components, importing hono/cookie into view code
findings.suggestion: Acceptable at this size, but consider splitting readTeam/writeTeam into a small team-service module if the feature grows

findings.issue: TypeBadge's link?: boolean is flag-parameter usage, mild but repeated at every call site pair
findings.suggestion: Either two components (TypeBadge/TypeLink) or an explicit 'variant' prop if more variants appear

summary: A small, disciplined codebase where the high-value seams were built right: all data access funnels through one module, every Pokémon-card list renders through one CardList component, and the abstractions absorbed the later team feature without copying. The weak seams are the triplicated card construction across loadHome/loadTeam/cardsForPokemon, the sort-key vocabulary split between the router and the moves table, and grab-bag/cross-feature modules (details.tsx, pokemon→team import) that make removal and addition a subtract-from-shared-file exercise rather than a file operation. Everything is greppable and no scenario required touching unrelated code, so this is comfortably above-average editability with clear, cheap fixes.
